ditto.obtainedAt: Wild encounters across Paldea (including outbreaks); also available via picnic eggs from a Ditto parent pair.

eggMoveAlternative.name: Mirror Herb
eggMoveAlternative.howItWorks: Held during a picnic, it copies egg moves from a partner that already knows them.

moveDescriptions.Dragon Dance: Raises the user's Attack and Speed by one stage each.

abilityDescriptions.Blaze: When this Pokémon's HP is at or below one-third, the power of its Fire-type moves is boosted.
abilityDescriptions.Solar Power: In harsh sunlight, Special Attack rises, but the Pokémon loses some HP at the end of each turn.

hatchRoutes.method: Let's Go mode while traveling — eggs hatch from steps taken in the overworld with a Pokémon out of its ball.
hatchRoutes.notes: Pair with Egg Power from a picnic sandwich to find eggs faster and hatch them faster.

hatchModifiers.name: Egg Power Sandwich
hatchModifiers.effect: Raises the chance of an egg appearing in the picnic basket and reduces hatch time. Lv. 3 is about 10× egg-find chance; exact Lv. 1/2 multipliers are not yet verified here.
hatchModifiers.availability: Cook at a picnic. Lv. 2 is reachable with common shop ingredients (for example a Great Peanut Butter Sandwich). Lv. 3 needs Herba Mystica from 5★+ Tera Raids.
